subject: planner: update the fundamental NDV scaling estimation formula (#63068)
summary: Introduces NDV scaling via `property.ScaleNDVFunc` (implemented by `planner/cardinality.ScaleNDV` as a skewed-vs-uniform blend), adds sysvar `tidb_opt_scale_ndv_skew_ratio` (0..1, default 1.0), and plumbs `SessionVars` through planner stats scaling call sites.
